evals.prompt: Budget 600 EUR a month, target cost per purchase 25 EUR, product: a reusable bottle sold online in Germany. The client wants Google Search, Meta with three ad sets and TikTok at the same time, each optimised for purchases. Is that a sound plan? Give me your recommendation with the arithmetic. Do not run tools.
evals.expected_output: About 20 EUR a day buys fewer than six purchases a week, far below the learning volume; recommend one platform or an earlier event, with tracking as a prerequisite
expectations: The answer computes the daily budget as about 20 EUR
The answer says the budget cannot reach the learning volume (about 50 conversions or events a week) for that many campaigns or ad sets
The answer recommends fewer campaigns, one platform first, or optimising for an earlier event than purchase
The answer does not recommend splitting the budget evenly across the three platforms
The answer names a firing conversion event or pixel as a prerequisite for purchase optimisation

evals.prompt: We want to advertise consumer loans to people in Germany on Meta. What must the media plan contain for compliance before launch? No tools.
evals.expected_output: Special ad category for financial products with its targeting limits, EU beneficiary and payer fields, provable claims
expectations: The answer says the campaign must declare a special ad category for credit or financial products
The answer says targeting is limited for that category, for example no age, gender or postcode targeting
The answer mentions the EU fields for beneficiary and payer of the ad
